title: Omni-Crack30k: A Benchmark for Crack Segmentation and the Reasonable Effectiveness of Transfer Learning
mechanism: 30k crack images from 20+ datasets as one benchmark; nnU-Net transfer learning beats all other approaches; tolerance metric clIoU@4px because strict IoU favours wide cracks.
adaptation: Use as the direct thin-crack evidence that the nnU-Net recipe should be run on EL, and adopt clIoU@k (k=2 for our 1-2 px labels) beside relF1@2 as a benchmark crack metric. OmniCrack30k pretraining of the crack head is D09's arm; do not duplicate.
min_experiment: Covered by the nnU-Net arm A; metric work: compute clIoU@2 and @4 for the house 5-seed ensemble and arm A on CV and E1; keep the metric if it ranks runs consistently with relF1@2 and has lower seed variance than strict IoU.
evidence: R: 30k samples, 9 billion pixels, asphalt / ceramic / concrete / masonry / steel; nnU-Net mean clIoU4px 64%, at least 10 points above all other approaches.
prior_overlap: none in BRIEF section 5; also listed in D09 (pretraining arm)

alt_notes.adaptation: (a) Crack-binary pretraining of the ResNet-34 U-Net++ on OmniCrack30k in grayscale at 512 px, then PF fine-tune on EL so the pretraining survives. (b) nnU-Net v2 auto-configured on our 24 classes as a benchmark row. (c) Adopt clIoU@k as a benchmark metric next to relF1@2.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: OmniCrack30k pretrain (20k steps) then PF; baseline PF from ImageNet; 3 seeds. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2, CV crack IoU, CV components >= 20 px found. Kill if E1 relF1@2 < +0.02 and CV crack IoU n.d.

alt_notes.adaptation: Add a tolerant centerline IoU at 2 px next to relF1@2 in our benchmark; include nnU-Net 2D as a required baseline; optional crack pretraining corpus.
alt_notes.min_experiment: CPU: compute clIoU@2px on existing predictions; GPU: nnU-Net 2D on the 5 folds vs house PF on crack relF1@2.

alt_notes.adaptation: (a) Pretrain the crack channel of the house model on OmniCrack30k in grayscale (512 crops), then PF fine-tune on EL so the pretraining survives. (b) Run nnU-Net v2 auto-configured on our 24 classes as a benchmark row. (c) Adopt clIoU@k next to relF1@2 in the benchmark protocol.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: OmniCrack30k crack pretraining then PF; baseline: PF from ImageNet; 3 seeds. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2, CV crack IoU, CV components >= 20 px found. Kill if E1 relF1@2 < +0.02 and CV crack IoU n.d. nnU-Net 5-fold as separate benchmark row.

alt_notes.adaptation: (a) Metric: add tolerance clIoU at 1, 2 and 4 px next to relF1@2, because EL crack labels jitter 1-2 px. (b) Score arm: convert OmniCrack30k to grayscale 512 crops, pretrain U-Net++/ResNet-34 as binary crack, then fine-tune on EL with PF so the encoder is kept.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: OmniCrack30k-pretrained U-Net++ R34, then PF fine-tune, 5 seeds. Baseline: PF 5-seed mean from ImageNet init. Metric: clean-49 crack IoU and E1 crack relF1@2. Kill: crack IoU gain < +0.01 AND E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.02.
